answer: Each identity keeps a relic of standing sealed in one epoch and unsealed in the next — a plume of trust grows only when the seal matches the work revealed, checked by established peers. A zephyr of fresh work must fill each relic, so a fake that seals nothing, or seals a lie, stays empty: each fake must do real work, seal it, and reveal it one epoch later, and the chain of seals must stay consistent, so a farm of a thousand fakes cannot bulk-buy standing — each one must seal and reveal, one relic at a time.
